title: MTP/AR output attribution is now proved against committed output spans
purpose: Replace arithmetic reconciliation with an attribution proof. ar_output_tokens is defined as completion - mtp, so the old reconciled flag accepted any split that added up; the response now also reports the committed cycle records that independently bound the speculative output, and with HIPENGINE_MTP2_OUTPUT_SPANS=1 the committed output spans (execution mode, reason, emitted-token position, token count) that must tile the committed output. This artifact is the same-protocol c=1 ShareGPT row with the diagnostic spans on.
hardware: AMD Radeon 8060S (gfx1151, Strix Halo), ROCm SDK from /home/lhl/miniforge3/envs/vllm

attribution_reading.identity: spanned_tokens + unspanned_tokens == completion_tokens (3067 + 5 = 3072) and unspanned_tokens == ar_output_tokens - ar_output_tokens_in_cycles (5 == 29 - 24)
attribution_reading.events_are_not_tokens: fallback_event_total is 24 (one no_provider refusal per request) while ar_output_tokens is 29: 24 of those tokens were emitted by the depth-zero no_provider cycle that opens each request and 5 were emitted after the plan retired, which is why the field is named fallback_event_counts and why token-level attribution is reported separately as span_accounting.ar_tokens_by_reason
attribution_reading.unspanned_tokens: The 5 unspanned tokens are the final token of 5 requests, emitted by the autoregressive decode that retires the row; the accounting helper deliberately does not record a span for a step whose row is already released
attribution_reading.all_speculative_output_is_spanned: spanned_mtp_tokens == mtp_output_tokens exactly (3043), so no speculative token is hiding in the unspanned remainder

diagnostic_value.first_spans_run: The first run of the span proof (same protocol, same server settings) reported 19/24 reconciled with 5 rows failing spans_do_not_reach_the_completion_count. That was a real accounting gap in the check, not in the engine: spans legitimately need not reach the completion count because the prefill root token and the retiring decode token are autoregressive tokens emitted outside the plan. The check was corrected to the identity above and the same protocol then proved 24/24. Recorded here because it is the evidence that the check discriminates rather than always passing.
diagnostic_value.reproduce_without_spans: Without HIPENGINE_MTP2_OUTPUT_SPANS the response reports the committed-cycle bounds and reconciled_reasons only, and the harness prints a note that no span proof was recorded.
